answer: Rule: no identity trades until its escrowed micro-task passes a random established peer check. Each new identity posts a 40-unit escrow and must complete one verified hour of real work first. A fake that fails loses its escrow, so a farm pays 40 units plus one work-hour per fake, and the attacker cost grows linearly, like pigment diluting across an ocean, while one honest lotus of real work keeps its stake.
